# HSKRC — Hassan Sabbah Knowledge & Research Centre

> An independent digital knowledge, library, and research archive focused on Hassan Sabbah, Alamut, Nizari Ismaili history, and related cultural heritage.

HSKRC aims to present historical research with traceable sources. It distinguishes documented evidence from interpretation and later tradition, and avoids presenting speculative reconstructions as historical fact.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://hskrc.org/)
- [Who Are the Ismailis? English–Persian Introduction](https://hskrc.org/ismaili-introduction.html): source-based overview of origins, the Fatimids, the 1094 succession dispute, Nizari Alamut, and the present, with explicit research limits.
- [About and Research Standards](https://hskrc.org/about.html): editorial principles, evidence standards, and research method.
- [Alamut Knowledge Base](https://hskrc.org/alamut-knowledge-base.html): connected research on Alamut, Hassan Sabbah, and related fortifications.
- [Hassan Sabbah](https://hskrc.org/hassan-sabbah.html): source-linked biographical research.
- [Alamut](https://hskrc.org/alamut.html): history, geography, and heritage documentation.
- [Digital Library](https://hskrc.org/library.html): bibliographic records and lawful access information.
- [Articles and Research](https://hskrc.org/articles.html): published research archive.
- [Research Explorer](https://hskrc.org/research-explorer.html): discovery across knowledge nodes, articles, sources, researchers, and library records.
- [Researchers and Scholars](https://hskrc.org/researchers.html): researchers whose work is represented in the archive.
- [Sources and References](https://hskrc.org/sources.html): registered scholarly, primary, and institutional references.
- [Editorial Policy](https://hskrc.org/editorial-policy.html): publication standards.
- [Contact and Feedback](https://hskrc.org/contact.html): contact the project.

## Research and citation principles

- Important historical claims should be linked to identifiable sources where possible.
- Primary sources, modern scholarship, institutional heritage records, and later traditions should be distinguished.
- Disputed dates and interpretations should retain their uncertainty.
- Inclusion of a researcher or institution does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
- Library records do not imply that HSKRC owns redistribution rights; access should follow the stated rights and licensing information.
